description:
This figure is a diagram of the GoogLeNet network architecture, showcasing its various layers and connections. The diagram includes convolutional layers (Conv), pooling layers (MaxPool), and concatenation layers (DepthConcat). It also highlights the use of local response normalization (LocalRespNorm) and average pooling (AveragePool). The network architecture is designed to go deeper with convolutions, as indicated by the title of the figure.
